name: Naruga N. Nebiros
source:
A Royale participant who proposed that Lucy should assassinate an angel.

He claims to be a former killer, but he's still very secretive. Even his name is only a pseudonym.

He's ruthless and out of control, yet always remains calm. Compared to Lucy he's bad at close combat, but he outwits his opponents with his high shooting abilities and clever tricks.

[Translated from [url=https://warabimochipizzacha.wixsite.com/heavensroyale]official website[/url]]
